annotation.title_clean: The roadmap to an effective AI assurance ecosystem
annotation.title_en: The roadmap to an effective AI assurance ecosystem
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation (CDEI), UK Government
annotation.summary_en: UK CDEI roadmap setting out steps to build a mature AI assurance industry within five years, as a market-based complement to regulation. It covers audits, impact assessments, certification, standards, professionalisation and skills, and assigns roles to government, regulators, industry and researchers. It contains no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision of a thriving UK AI assurance ecosystem within five years, potentially a multi-billion pound industry.
Assurance seen as a market-based complement to regulation and a way to build justified trust in AI.
Identifies priorities including standards, professionalisation of assurance providers, and common understanding of what to assure.
Sets out a spectrum of assurance mechanisms from impact assessment to formal verification.
Defines CDEI's role in advising on the AI governance White Paper and convening stakeholders.
